From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Acme POC - environment setup dependencies (VPC, IP allowlists, SSO, KMS)

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Per our conversation, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that focuses on the POC environment milestones we discussed. High level: we want to get a working POC in your staging VPC so your product team can validate latency and end-to-end data flows.

Key MAP milestone for this thread: POC environment setup dependencies
- Target milestone completion: Oct 21, 2026 (target POC demo week of Oct 25)
- Owners: Acme infra / Acme security (listed below) + Redwood delivery/infra

Dependencies (requested items from Acme):
1) VPC peering / private connectivity: Acme infra to establish peering or AWS Transit config with Redwood dedicated VPC. We will provide VPC CIDR and sample Terraform. Owner: Acme infra (Sam Jacobs).
2) IP allowlists: Acme security/network to add Redwood egress IPs to allowlist for API endpoints and health checks. We will share a short list of egress IPs and ranges. Owner: Acme network (Priya Singh).
3) SSO/SAML: Acme IdP team to provide SAML metadata (IdP XML) and test user accounts for SAML login. If you prefer OIDC, we can adapt but the POC plan currently assumes SAML. Owner: Acme SSO/IdP (Priya).
4) Secrets / KMS access: If you want to bring your own KMS key, please provide the ARN and service account IAM role we should use to access secrets. Alternatively Redwood can host keys in our Tenant-managed keyspace for the POC -- let us know preference. Owner: Acme security.

Redwood deliverables and owners:
- Provide MAP draft, sandbox config, and sample Terraform for peering: Marissa (Delivery) + Nikhil (Infra)
- Provide list of egress IPs, port requirements, and healthcheck endpoints: Nikhil
- Provide SAML SP metadata and test instructions for Redwood side: Nikhil

Attachments: redwood-map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP), poe-network-diagram.png (network sketch). Link to editable MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3c4d-redwood-map-draft

Next steps / asks for this week:
- Can Acme confirm owners for the four dependency items above and expected availability windows?
- Can Priya or Sam share estimated dates when network/SAML work can begin (we recommended week of Oct 4 for initial connectivity work)?

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min sync next week to walk through the MAP if helpful.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Marissa,

Thanks -- this is great and maps to what we discussed. Quick answers:
- Sam (infra) will lead VPC peering; I've looped him in. He has a travel day Oct 1-3 but can kick off the spec next week (Oct 4).
- Priya (network/ID) is the owner for IP allowlist + SSO items; she's on leave until Oct 6, so earliest active work is Oct 7.
- For KMS, security prefers we provide a customer-managed key (we can give you the ARN). I'll confirm with the security team and share the contact.

Question: do you need the full Terraform from us, or is a peering connection + route table updates sufficient for the POC? Also, for SAML, we will need SP metadata from Redwood -- can you share the SP entityID and ACS URL?

We're aligned on the Oct 25 demo window. If network/SAML work can start the week of Oct 4-11 that should give us wiggle room.

Thanks,
Alex
